greatsword.name: Vanguard
greatsword.armour: Layered plate and leather armour, with a travelling cloak
greatsword.accessories: A metal cloak clasp and practical leather belt fittings
greatsword.armour_design: Medium-to-heavy plate over padded cloth or mail. Broad shoulders and reinforced forearms; retain the existing portrait's colours.
greatsword.accessory_design: Cloak clasp or service medallion; an optional strength charm is a future item, not an assumed enchantment.

sword.name: Duelist
sword.armour: A fitted leather or metal cuirass with protective bracers
sword.accessories: Cloak or shoulder fastenings and a sword belt
sword.armour_design: Light-to-medium protection, allowing quick movement. Human and elf portraits use cuirasses; orc portraits can retain scale armour.
sword.accessory_design: A fastening brooch or belt ornament; a precision charm may be designed later.

hammer_shield.name: Guardian
hammer_shield.armour: Heavy armour with layered shoulder protection and sturdy gauntlets
hammer_shield.accessories: Metal armour fastenings, a heavy belt and cloak fittings
hammer_shield.armour_design: Heavy plate or mail-and-plate with a padded underlayer. Large shield and substantial hammer keep the silhouette broad.
hammer_shield.accessory_design: Service emblem, oath token or protective charm are thematic choices. Only visible fittings are described as equipped until inspected.

staff.name: Mage
staff.armour: Loose layered robes and a short mantle rather than heavy armour
staff.accessories: Decorative robe fastenings, pendants and a leather belt
staff.armour_design: Oversized fully covering robes, long sleeves and practical boots; small youthful build. Staff crystal belongs to the weapon.
staff.accessory_design: A focus pendant or crystal charm suits the class; visible jewellery is not automatically magical or expensive.

prayer_book.name: Cleric
prayer_book.armour: Layered clerical robes and a mantle with embroidered trim
prayer_book.accessories: Religious robe emblems, metal fastenings and a belt
prayer_book.armour_design: Modest robes with a stole or mantle; no invented steel armour. Ordinary portraits have youthful proportions; outlaw clergy may look older.
prayer_book.accessory_design: Holy symbol, reliquary or prayer beads are possible future accessories. Do not claim beads or a reliquary are visible in every portrait.

bow.name: Ranger
bow.armour: Leather protection with bracers and a travelling cloak
bow.accessories: A cloak clasp, leather straps and a quiver harness
bow.armour_design: Light leather, flexible layered clothing and a short cloak. Mature, composed silhouette; keep the visible bow and quiver.
bow.accessory_design: A trail brooch or tracking charm suits the class. Quiver and bracers are equipment rather than magical jewellery.
